description: 2024 winter maintenance had a $6.5 million deficit, covered by surplus.
City will upgrade snow plow lighting for improved visibility.
A review of priority streets is planned for 2027.

chips.text: Staff clarified 2024 deficit covered by corporate surplus, not snow reserve.
Snow management facilities collect meltwater and grit to prevent pollution.
Lighting upgrade for plows will cost less than $100,000.

description: Over 40% of city buses are in poor condition; new buses will arrive by 2026 to improve fleet reliability.

chips.text: Condition rating for buses is primarily age-based, not safety.
Transit users face potential service disruptions due to fleet condition.
Fleet renewal plan provides annual funding for new bus purchases up to 2030.

description: Fire Community Support provides non-enforcement support on transit and BIDs.
It addresses non-violent social disorder and improves public safety.
Council requested a report on Indigenous-led peacekeepers for transit.

chips.text: Staff confirmed a budget request for more Fire Community Support workers and dispatchers.
Staff could not provide an exact number for optimal additional Fire Community Support officers.

description: City forms working group for construction site accessibility.
Group addresses concerns from Accessibility Advisory Committee.
Administration will report outcomes back to this committee.

chips.text: Councillor Pearce moved for an outcome report back to the committee.
Construction site barriers impact residents with disabilities, seniors
Accessibility Advisory Committee chair detailed barriers like blocked curb cuts
City staff will engage the contracting industry to resolve issues before next construction season.
